name: Hollow Choirling
loreTies: A small mouthless choir-husk that hums erased prayers until Deity battle pattern timing begins to slip.
Stays behind Wretches and applies silence pressure to isolated lanes.
Erasure is not death; erasure is ownership without memory.
shortBackstory: Hollow Choirling is a Hollow threat creature built for campaign and event encounters, turning erased memory into minor battlefield pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Hollow Choirling formed where the Hollow learned a specific weakness in remembered civilization. It is not a Deity, not a citizen, and not a recruitable unit; it is a symptom of the Gate giving absence a body.

chapters.title: Hollow Function
chapters.text: Its role inside the Hollow threat faction is precise: Stays behind Wretches and applies silence pressure to isolated lanes. This lets mission designers select it by encounter tags instead of treating Hollow enemies as one shapeless swarm.

chapters.title: Lore Tie
chapters.text: A small mouthless choir-husk that hums erased prayers until Deity battle pattern timing begins to slip.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: Hollow Choirling can appear in Normal missions, Elite remixes, Hollow Breach events, Ascension floors, and raid add waves when its tags match the objective pressure. It must always reinforce Hollowing: isolation, corrupted memory, broken objectives, or stolen meaning.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Art and gameplay must keep Hollow Choirling visibly non-playable. Its silhouette uses small bent humanoid with a smooth unfinished face, throat full of white fracture lines, ash ribbons floating from its shoulders. while its abilities — Silence Hymn, Battle Pattern Stutter — create battlefield pressure without confusing it for a faction Deity.

developmentStatus: Readable Hollow creature profile integrated into campaign/event threat pages.
